title: Sacroiliitis in Systemic Sclerosis
brief_summary: One of the major problems of systemic sclerosis (SSc) patients is suggested to be articular involvement. Mostly involved joints in SSc were reported as wrist, carpometacarpal-interphalangeal, foot, knee, hip and shoulder however there have been little knowledge on sacroiliac joint. Here the investigators plan a study on the involvement of this joint in SSc.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed as systemic sclerosis and rheumatoid arthritis and healthy volunteers

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not giving informed consent
study_population: Consecutive systemic sclerosis and rheumatoid arthritis patients and healthy volunteers
